title: Brand-overlay crossfade (Springs)
source: springs.estate Place→Jogging seam (доводчик акт→акт, D_SPRINGS_video seam table). Engine = library/components/brand-overlay-crossfade (proven). Dual wrapper adds manualDrive + two modes (push/wash).
engine: Two seam modes on ONE engine. mode:'push' (desktop) = a second full-bleed photo pushed over the first from below with a magnetic overshoot-settle; render(prog) = its translateY. mode:'wash' (mobile) = a brand-colour wash draining wash→0; render(prog) = wash*(1-prog).
differs: DIFFERENT mechanics per platform (empirical — springs itself splits the доводчик by boundary, D_SPRINGS_video): desktop = PUSH-OVER смугою (a second photo slides up over the first, over-travels past the target, springs back — magnetic settle), scrubbed by scroll while pinned (reversible). mobile = CROSSFADE (brand wash drains wash→0 over time on mount) — a bottom/side вріз reads unnatural on a narrow screen, so springs replaces the push with a long opacity-tween, no вріз.

desktop.driver: scrollPush (mode:'push') — prog = scroll progress across the pin span; drives the next photo's translateY 100%→0 with an overshoot-settle. Reversible.

mobile.driver: autoDrain (mode:'wash') — prog ramps 0→1 once over drainMs on mount; drives wash*(1-prog) crossfade.

wash.what: starting wash opacity (brand cover → tints to 0).

fadeImage.what: also crossfade the image 0→1 (only on a brand-coloured backdrop).

pinFactor.what: pin length as a fraction of viewport (desktop scroll span).

engine_patch: forceMotion (skip the <=820px static guard) + manualDrive (expose render() without the engine's own ScrollTrigger/pin). Both additive & opt-in; default behavior unchanged. See memory dual-platform-forcemotion.
entry: BrandOverlayCrossfadeDual.init(target, opts) -> { platform, engine, driver }. Load engine.js THEN component.js. Markup: .boc-stage > .boc-img(img) + .boc-img--next(img, push mode) + .boc-wash(brand-colour) [+ .boc-content].
law: Lenis→ticker→ScrollTrigger only on desktop-via-wrapper; render(prog) PURE; transform (push) / opacity (wash) only; GPU; NO mix-blend/backdrop over the scrubbed surface; NO WebGL. reduced-motion → resolved (desktop: next photo settled in; mobile: wash 0).
